_doc: TC-PIN (decision 0004 item 3, decision 0018). Hash pins for the OPTIONAL theorycraft calc component: an unmodified Path of Building PoE2 source archive and a LuaJIT source archive, fetched by scripts/setup.ps1 (tools/tc_pin.py) into the AL sidecar only when the user opts in (setup.ps1 -TcCalc or config/local.json "tc_calc": true). Every value was read from the public GitHub API / archives on the verified date; the archive sha256 was computed from two independent downloads. A missing or malformed value makes setup refuse; never guess one. The pin moves only by a commit with the bridge tests green. No absolute paths here.

toolchain._doc: Decision 0026. OPTIONAL portable C toolchain used ONLY to build luajit.exe when no system compiler is on PATH. Fetched into the AL sidecar Cache only on the -TcCalc opt-in, never installed, never on the user or machine PATH, never vendored. sha256 = the GitHub release asset digest, re-computed from two independent downloads.
toolchain.name: WinLibs MinGW-w64 (GCC 16.2.0, UCRT, posix-seh)
